title: The Crimson Horizon
description: When a deep-space extraction crew uncovers an ancient signal beyond the outer rim, one rogue pilot must outrun a corporate armada to deliver the truth to Earth.

title: Vengeance in Chennai
description: An undercover tactical officer infiltrates a high-stakes coastal smuggling syndicate in a relentless race against time before monsoon nightfall.

title: Midnight Frequencies
description: A late-night radio host receives an encrypted broadcast predicting unsolved crimes across the city—until the next voice on the line is his own.

title: Golden Monsoons
description: Spanning three generations of a legendary cinema family, an aspiring director fights to save their historic single-screen theater.

title: Zero Gravity Laughs
description: When four mismatched wedding caterers accidentally board a commercial orbital shuttle, they have 48 hours to fake astronaut credentials.

title: Neon Ronin
description: In a rain-drenched cyber metropolis, a retired blade master returns to protect the young hacker holding the keys to the city grid.
